Want to suffer from some ancient mathematics?
Chimú mathematics, to be more precise.

Khipus are mathematics, and Chimor would naturally develop them further.

[b]Basic Mathematics[/b]

In Chimú mathematics, there is a main cord called the Chimpi, from which all other cords hang. The Chimpi represents the total value.

The cords hanging from it are called [i]Kaus[/i]. Each Kaus is a part of the total, and regardless of how they are arranged, they always result in the same Chimpi.

This principle is known as the Chimpikaus Rule:
[i]"The order of the Kaus does not change the Chimpi."[/i]

Or, in more familiar terms, this is known as commutativity , an idea as old as the khipus themselves, thought it would not me named until the 4th century BCE, by simply uniting chimpi+ kaus into Chimpikaus.
Chimpi = C  
Kaus = K  
Where:
C = K₁ + K₂ + ... + Kₙ  
Or, in a more formal form:
[b]Chimpikaus Rule:[/b]
C = ∑ K_i, and for any arrangement of the Kaus, the total remains C.
[b]The concept of nothing.[/b]
Iàkac (pronounce like iaokas) was a concept of a placeholder number which surged around the 3rd century BCE, it was treated as a void between numbers, larger numbers, the iàkac was essentially made for things not go to confusing, but this nothing was not treated as a number.
Example: 
________(main cord)
Knot of hundred.
/(Simple empty space)
Knot of unit.
This means
Hundred value+[no dozens]+ Unit.

Eventually, at the 4th century after Christ, finally the number received a....well, better saying, it became a number properly saying, around taht century, the iàkac would be used alone when a stock would end, before, there would be simply...no knot representing it, but now, there was a certain knot for the concept of iàkac, the zero, it had no twist, and was a simple knot taht would not be twisted to anywhere.
The idea was simple.
[i]If I add something into this, nothing happens, if I subtract this from this, nothing happens, if a group has nothing, no matter how many groups have, the value of what they carry will always be a iàkac.[/i]
*Important note: a twisted knot to the left is negative value and a twisted knot to the right is positive
[b] Calculus to predict lunar cycles, alignments and eclipses.[/b]
The predictions of cycles from the archaic Chimor peoples started at as long as the Ceramic period and potentially the Archaic, made by more rittes and observations rather pratic proper, however, the at around the 6th to the 3th century BCE, there were more precise ways to know when next astronomical events would happen.
Some explanations:
Uillakànu: a calendar focused on dry and humid seasons which lasted 2 cycles of 7 months, however each cycle was a year, the Uilla was the rainy and the Kànu the dry one, by dry it means the rivers would retreat and allow agriculture, each cycle was considered individually a year.
Regnal cycles: the Vikán made this calendar to mark the lunar cycles their kápas would rule, this means a emperor could have reigns of "hundreds" of years according to this, think about it:
A emperor with 4 years of reign sounds small, but one with 48 cycles sounds bigger and more prestigious.
Now, for calculating the lunar position, they would:
L(small n taht does not appear here)= L(0 anything between those paren things are small numbers)+...ok Chimor make it better
Ok now fully:
L(n)=[i]([/i]L(0)+[N-N[b]([/b]0[b])[/b]]∆L[i])[/i] MOD 360⁰
Where:
L= lunar cycle.
N= regnal cycle we want to know.
n=number of the regnal cycle.
L(0)= lunar position at this cycle.
∆l= lunar variation
Mod 360= the angular advancement of the moon.
Let's assume that in the regnal cycle n=5 the lunar position is L(0)=30⁰. Knowing that the Moon advances on average ∆L=45⁰ per regnal cycle, what will be the lunar position in the regnal cycle N=12? Use the formula:

L(N)=[i]([/i]L(0)+[N-N[b]([/b]0[b])[/b]]∆L[i])[/i] MOD 360⁰
This is
L(12)=(30⁰+[12-5]45)MOD360
L(12)=(30+745)MOD360.
L(12)=(30+315)MOD360
L(12)=345 MOD 360.
Since 345< MOD 360,
L(12)=345⁰.
So an almost full moon.

[b]ALAQAN ELECTIONS ARE CONCLUDED[/b]

The Alaqan elections for the first Kansler have ended, and the results have been counted and confirmed as of today. The Xalqsudi will be receiving its first representatives, and the Davlatsudi has had their officials appointed by their state governments. The results of the elections have been released to the Alaqan public and international bodies have received the information.

Aytolun Yosma has won the race for head of the executive branch, securing the ANPs hold on the new Alaqan government. Yosma celebrated her victory with a speech delivered last Sunday, declaring that Alaqar is entering a new age under a fresh and modern leadership, perhaps for the first time. Yosma was officially made Tomkansler of Alaqar on July 14th, 2028, firmly cementing Alaqars new status as a republic. Yosma will serve as the Tomkansler of Alaqar for the next 6 years. Parpilov Kovir, her running mate for the election, was made Vice Kansler on the same day, and has promised to the Alaqan public to keep the dream of twinks, tomboys and republicanism a reality.

The Xalqsudi and its representatives were also voted on over the spring, and results seemed to have also been in favor of the ANP, albeit with more CC and DUP influence. For reference, there are 541 seats in the Xalqsudi which are divided on area and population. 271 seats are needed to secure a majority in the Xalqsudi. Out of 541 seats, 325 have been brought under sway of the Alaqan National Party, 135 under the CC, and  81 under the DUP. The Xalqsudi has an ANP majority to support Yosma in her term as Tomkansler.

The Davlatsudi has been elected by the state governments of Alaqar, and the results are in the same pattern as the Xalqsudi. The ANP has secured a majority in both of the legislative houses of Alaqar, a massive victory for both the legitimacy of the new Alaqan republic and the ANP.

Yosma has inherited the Alaqan seat. Time will tell if this new and fragile government will last.

[b]Withdrawal from Xahu Island[/b]

From: Brother of Mario and Vice President, Luigi Mario

To: President of Yulandburg, Pahinha Balduo

Written on April 23rd, 2028

The Government has formally decided to bring an end to the long-standing Zuiden/Xahu Island dispute that started in 2009.

Imperium Romae Marii will first officially recognize Xahu Island as part of the sovereign territory of the Yussrian Commonwealth Empire of Yulandburg, at April 24, 2028.

After that, all Romariian patrol vessels and military ships currently near Xahu Island will be withdrawn beginning at April 25, 2028.

Given everything happening both in and outside of the nation, we believe this step will be a stepping stone to reducing tensions and avoiding the situation from becoming worse.

We hope this decision can help improve relations between our nations in the future.

From,
Vice President of Imperium Romae Marii, Luigi Mario
